description: EARLY ACCESS (returns 403 EMAIL_EARLY_ACCESS until general availability). Import a CSV of contacts into an email list. The server fetches source_url over https (50 MB cap) and writes the contacts in one call, so this changes who a campaign will reach. Omit mapping to let the server recognize a common ESP export; if no email column is found the call returns 400 with the headers it read, so retry with a mapping. The consent source records how these people agreed to hear from you and is required. Requires confirm: true.

allow_role.description: Accept role addresses (info@, sales@) instead of rejecting them.

confirm.description: Must be true to run this write operation. Set it only after the user has explicitly confirmed.

consent_note.description: Optional detail about the consent, up to 1000 characters.

consent_source.description: How the people in this file consented to hear from you.

email_domain_id.description: Scope the new list to one sending domain. Omit for an organization-wide list any campaign can use.

mapping.description: CSV header to contact field. Omit to use the server recognizer.

name.description: Name for the list this file becomes. Defaults to the file name. The file IS the list: an import creates one rather than adding to an existing list.

source_url.description: https URL of the CSV file.

name: start_email_list_import
